notes: The leaf is entirely graphical apart from its captions and manuscript pagination 105. It has five drawings, of which the middle-left drawing is cancelled. There is no visible date or title. H's introductory note calling it a page of four figures is editorial and was not transcribed or counted as a source-text discrepancy.

All five figures have been reconstructed on one TikZ surface in the same two-column arrangement, with the fifth below the left column. The coordinate geometry follows the source image. This replaces C's tabular/figure wrapping as a representation change only; no collation row was created for the wrapping or for prose-versus-TikZ syntax.

H was supplied only as textual drawing descriptions. No underlying H project drawing files were supplied, so those drawings cannot be assessed. H comparisons in changes refer only to concrete labels, arrows or construction details absent from, or contradicted by, the supplied text; they do not establish omissions in an unavailable drawing file.

Figure 1's current relation count is definitely 2. The dark vertical remnant could belong to an earlier 1, as H proposes, but the underlying glyph and separate cancellation are not secure. A doubtful deleted 1 and live 2 preserve the possible rewriting without presenting it as settled.

The six named circular arcs and three connectors in figure 1 retain their directions: the top infinity arc runs left-to-right, the lower infinity arc right-to-left; the upper 0 and 1 arcs run from their right basepoints toward the left, and the lower arcs in the opposite directions. The connectors are a^1 from the infinity-left point to zero-left, a^∞ from zero-right to one-left, and a^0 from one-right to infinity-right.

Figure 2 retains both drawn arrowheads at the zero loop's right side, the complete infinity loop, the two arcs around 1, and the two surviving labelled connectors. A pale left-side connection and other guide strokes remain pale; they are not silently promoted to dark generators.

The middle-left drawing is crossed out as a region. Its source cancellation pattern is reproduced with diagonal and looping strokes over the drawing instead of imposing additional horizontal strikes separately through every symbol. The source's ∞,0,1 and both visible connectors remain in the reconstruction. Its caption is retained as 3|1 cas, explicitly unresolved. No combinatorial expectation was used to choose the numeral.

A pointed ending survives on the upper-right side of the cancelled zero circle. It is reproduced by its V-like strokes. Whether it should be regarded as another arrowhead rather than a retraced ending is not settled, and no extra generator is inferred from it.
Both fourth-figure Λ labels have a prime before the upper 1. M0519 and M0520 are certainty-only resolutions of C's first readings and therefore have no separate content-change rows.

The label over the final one-circle is A_+^{01}. The horizontal bar is physically present and differentiates it from the barless capital Λ in the preceding figures. A possible intended Λ is a mathematical/editorial possibility, not the source reading; the clear A is preserved.

The crossed connector label in the last drawing remains unsure a^∞. Its lower a-like loop and upper double-loop remnant are visible, but the cancellation prevents a secure reading. The outgoing and returning connectors are separately reproduced, including the clear leftward arrowhead on the lower return.

Pale circular construction traces and small dark returns along circles are reproduced as visible graphical strokes. Changes to these traces are marked as drawing details, not mathematical consequences. The final source count of 1 sommet and 2 flèches is retained even though the drawn composite route has several geometric segments and dark endpoint marks.

The live caption counts are (V,E,R)=(6,9,2),(4,6,1),(2,3,0),(1,2,0). Their arithmetic consistency was actually checked, as detailed in check_events. This does not establish independence of the relations, which are not written out on this leaf.

The two loop/inverse formulae in figure 4 were checked under the explicit interpretation that the plus and minus loops traverse the same based circle in opposite directions. An explicit backtracking homotopy is given in the check event. This check does not identify the final A label with a Λ label.
No verbal author check or doubt annotation is present. The source's visible revisions consist of the overworked first count, the cancelled middle-left drawing, and the crossed final connector label.

The original was viewed once for layout, followed by each supplied full-resolution half once. Six unresolved locations received exactly one enlarged contextual crop each, using the recorded original-pixel boxes, LANCZOS enlargement to 3000-pixel width, autocontrast and mild sharpening. No OCR, external research, other-page reading or LaTeX compilation was used.

In the fourth caption, both drafts give trois. A final token check found a dotted upright after tro- and no securely separate s; the proposal therefore reads unsure troi|trois. This spelling uncertainty does not change the indicated quantity of three arrows. One further tight crop was made for this previously unresolved word.

It does not certify independence of the stated relations or an isomorphism of the presented groupoids.

check_events.statement: If the two signed loops at the same basepoint traverse the same parametrized circle in opposite directions, their classes are inverses, giving the two displayed fourth-figure inverse equalities.
check_events.outcome: Let γ:[0,1]→Y be the loop and h(t)=min(2t,2−2t). The concatenation γ followed by its reversal is γ(h(t)). The continuous homotopy H(s,t)=γ((1−s)h(t)) fixes t=0,1 at the basepoint and contracts the concatenation to γ(0). Repeating the argument for the reversed loop contracts the opposite concatenation. Thus the signed loop classes are inverses under the stated interpretation. No identification of A_+^{01} with a Λ symbol is used.
